dogecoin.text: The price of #dogecoin spiked as much as 34% to an all-time high of $0.095896 on Tuesday, bringing its total market capitalization above $11 billion. #Dogecoins #doge
The price of a single #dogecoin jumped as much as 20% on Tuesday to 42 cents, nearing Friday's all-time high of 45 cents, according to @CoinDesk data. #Bitcoin #DogeDay #cryptocurrencies
